title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page…
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 have a Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This vulnerability could be exploited remotely by an unauthenticated attacker with high attack complexity and requiring user interaction. Successful exploitation may lead to information tampering.
